**手机安装：只需下载 [`dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.3.0/dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk)。**

`update.json` 和 `SHA256SUMS` 供自动更新与校验使用，无需手动下载。GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 是源码包，不是安装包。

**Install on your phone: download [`dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.3.0/dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk).**

`update.json` and `SHA256SUMS` support automatic updates and verification. You do not need to download them manually. GitHub's Source code archives are not installers.

### 中文

- **顶栏一键语音通话。** 首页右上角、新对话按钮旁边多了通话按钮，新对话里也能直接打。
- **长按就能选字。** 长按回复或自己发的消息直接选中按到的词，拖两端改范围；选区上有复制、引用、分享、朗读、全选，「更多」里是原来的消息菜单。自己发的消息也能引用了。朗读选中的文字时，里面的密码、密钥不会念出来。
- **远程主机：对话备份和网页版。** 远程主机页可以把主机上的对话加密备份到手机，再恢复到原来的或另一台主机（每次恢复新建对话，不覆盖；附件和工作区源码不迁移）。主机支持时，还能在 App 里直接打开主机的 DSH 网页版，不用把登录凭据交给浏览器；服务繁忙时会提示「人太多了，请稍后重试」。
- **后台保护（需要自己打开）。** 设置里新增后台运行保护，默认关闭。打开后本机长任务切到后台更不容易被系统杀掉，被系统收回时如实显示，不会假装还在运行。iOS 可以选静音音频或后台定位来保活，都要自己授权，不保存也不上传位置。
- **酒馆。**
  - 支持酒馆助手脚本库：全局、预设、角色卡里的脚本都能运行。预设的脚本能拿到 SillyTavern 的事件和当前预设，像小猫之神这类预设的菜单现在能出来；脚本面板在画布里显示，开关会写回预设。
  - 大卡明显不卡了：重卡导入、卡库列表、长历史显示快了数倍，卡库占用减少约三分之二。前端卡只渲染屏幕上看得见的消息，写回复时少了很多多余重建。新增「省电渲染」开关（酒馆设置 › 显示，默认关）：关掉卡片网页里的毛玻璃，循环动画只播一遍。
  - 上下文满了一次裁掉一截，而不是每条都裁，模型的缓存能持续命中，更快也更省钱（默认开）。
  - 前端卡的开场白不再显示成一堆代码；深色模式下卡片颜色和网页文字看得清；酒馆界面统一了间距、样式和文案，加了克制的动效。
- **伙伴小屋更清晰。** 小屋按屏幕本身的像素密度渲染（之前最多按 2 倍），卡顿时临时降低的清晰度流畅后会自己升回来。
- **新桌宠「小粉鱼」。** 第三只内置宠物，带 18 种状态动画和 3 段待机小动作；切换动作时淡入淡出。
- **分享长图。** 分享成图片时保留完整正文，生成一张长图，不再截掉后半段。
- **本机引擎默认用 tawcroot 启动**（Android 10 及以上）：启动更快；起不来会自动退回原来的兼容启动（PRoot），不弹故障卡。之前手动关过的保持原样。卓易通上 PRoot 启动失败时，故障卡上会出现「用 tawcroot 启动」。
- **修复。** 升级到 1.1.0 后本机新建对话失败；本机用久了会话列表超过 8 MB 就整个加载失败；配了多台 DNS 时第一台拒绝就联网失败；插件配置里 API Key 填不进去；Android 10 用 Shizuku 授权后手机操控报「身份改变」；HyperOS / Android 16 一直 60 Hz（刷新率设置现在也作用到画面本身）；APK 已下好但空间只够一份时误报空间不足；同一路径的图片被覆盖后，旧消息里显示成新图；模型列表接口返回 404 时现在会提示可以手动添加模型；模型选择里过长的名字显示不全；伙伴自动想起记忆时误把子代理配置当成对话内容；桌宠、悬浮窗菜单、伙伴小组件和网页岛的几处显示问题。
- **验证情况。** 这一版的新功能大部分只经过自动测试和编译检查，tawcroot 默认启动、后台保护、远程备份和网页版都没有在各种真机上完整走过。iOS 安装包等 CI 编完会补到这个版本下；鸿蒙 HAP 这一版仍不提供。遇到问题请导出诊断并开 issue。

### English

- **One-tap voice call in the top bar.** A call button sits next to New chat in the top right, and works from a new chat too.
- **Long-press to select text.** Long-press a reply or your own message to select the word under your finger, then drag the handles. The selection bar has Copy, Quote, Share, Read aloud and Select all; More opens the usual message menu. Your own messages can be quoted too. Reading a selection aloud skips any passwords or keys in it.
- **Remote hosts: chat backup and the web app.** The remote host page can back up the host's chats to the phone, encrypted, and restore them to the same or another host (each restore makes a new chat and overwrites nothing; attachments and workspace source are not moved). When the host supports it, you can open its DSH web app inside the app without handing your credentials to a browser; when the service is busy it says so and asks you to try later.
- **Background protection (opt-in).** Settings has a new background protection option, off by default. When on, long local tasks are less likely to be killed in the background, and when the system takes the time back the app says so instead of pretending the engine is still running. On iOS you can choose silent audio or background location to keep it alive; both need your permission, and location is never stored or sent.
- **Tavern.**
  - Tavern Helper script library: scripts from global settings, presets and character cards all run. Preset scripts get SillyTavern's event source and the current preset, so menus from presets such as Meowssiah now show up; the script panel shows in the canvas and its switches are written back to the preset.
  - Large cards no longer stutter: importing heavy cards, the card library list and long histories are several times faster, and the card library takes about a third of the space. Frontend cards only render the messages on screen, and writing a reply triggers far fewer rebuilds. A new Power-saving rendering switch (Tavern settings › Display, off by default) turns off frosted glass in card pages and plays looping animations once.
  - When the context fills up, it is trimmed in one larger step instead of one message at a time, so the model's cache keeps hitting: faster and cheaper (on by default).
  - Frontend cards' opening messages no longer show as raw code; card colors and web text are readable in dark mode; the Tavern screens have consistent spacing, styles and wording, with restrained motion.
- **Sharper companion room.** The room renders at the screen's own pixel density (it was capped at 2x before), and resolution lowered during stutters comes back once things are smooth.
- **New pet: Pink Fish.** A third built-in pet with 18 state animations and 3 idle moments; switching animations now fades.
- **Long share images.** Sharing as an image keeps the whole message and makes one long image instead of cutting off the end.
- **The local engine starts with tawcroot by default** (Android 10 and later): faster to start; if it can't start, the app falls back to the compatible launcher (PRoot) on its own without an error card. If you turned tawcroot off before, that is kept. On Zhuoyitong, when PRoot fails to start the error card offers Start with tawcroot.
- **Fixes.** New local chats failing after upgrading to 1.1.0; the local chat list failing to load once it grew past 8 MB; no network when the first of several configured DNS servers refused; API keys that couldn't be entered in plugin settings; phone control reporting "identity changed" on Android 10 after Shizuku authorization; HyperOS / Android 16 stuck at 60 Hz (the refresh rate setting now applies to the drawing surface too); a false out-of-space error when the APK was already downloaded; older messages showing the new image after a file at the same path was overwritten; a 404 from the model list now says models can be added by hand; long model names cut off in the model picker; the companion's automatic memory recall mistaking subagent settings for conversation; several display issues in pets, the floating menu, the companion widget and web islands.
- **Testing.** Most new features in this version have only been checked by automated tests and builds; tawcroot by default, background protection, remote backup and the web app have not been fully tried on a range of real devices. The iOS package will be added to this release once CI finishes; there is still no HarmonyOS HAP in this version. If you run into a problem, please export diagnostics and open an issue.

- **修复。** 升级到 1.1.0 后本机新建对话失败；本机用久了会话列表超过 8 MB 就整个加载失败；配了多台 DNS 时第一台拒绝就联网失败；插件配置里 API Key 填不进去；Android 10 用 Shizuku 授权后手机操控报「身份改变」；HyperOS / Android 16 一直 60 Hz（刷新率设置现在也作用到画面本身）；APK 已下好但空间只够一份时误报空间不足；同一路径的图片被覆盖后，旧消息里显示成新图；模型列表接口返回 404 时现在会提示可以手动添加模型；模型选择里过长的名字显示不全；伙伴自动想起记忆时误把子代理配置当成对话内容；桌宠、悬浮窗菜单、伙伴小组件和网页岛的几处显示问题。
- **验证情况。** 这一版的新功能大部分只经过自动测试和编译检查，tawcroot 默认启动、后台保护、远程备份和网页版都没有在各种真机上完整走过。iOS 安装包等 CI 编完会补到这个版本下；鸿蒙 HAP 这一版仍不提供。遇到问题请导出诊断并开 issue。

### English

- **One-tap voice call in the top bar.** A call button sits next to New chat in the top right, and works from a new chat too.
- **Long-press to select text.** Long-press a reply or your own message to select the word under your finger, then drag the handles. The selection bar has Copy, Quote, Share, Read aloud and Select all; More opens the usual message menu. Your own messages can be quoted too. Reading a selection aloud skips any passwords or keys in it.
- **Remote hosts: chat backup and the web app.** The remote host page can back up the host's chats to the phone, encrypted, and restore them to the same or another host (each restore makes a new chat and overwrites nothing; attachments and workspace source are not moved). When the host supports it, you can open its DSH web app inside the app without handing your credentials to a browser; when the service is busy it says so and asks you to try later.
- **Background protection (opt-in).** Settings has a new background protection option, off by default. When on, long local tasks are less likely to be killed in the background, and when the system takes the time back the app says so instead of pretending the engine is still running. On iOS you can choose silent audio or background location to keep it alive; both need your permission, and location is never stored or sent.
- **Tavern.**
  - Tavern Helper script library: scripts from global settings, presets and character cards all run. Preset scripts get SillyTavern's event source and the current preset, so menus from presets such as Meowssiah now show up; the script panel shows in the canvas and its switches are written back to the preset.
  - Large cards no longer stutter: importing heavy cards, the card library list and long histories are several times faster, and the card library takes about a third of the space. Frontend cards only render the messages on screen, and writing a reply triggers far fewer rebuilds. A new Power-saving rendering switch (Tavern settings › Display, off by default) turns off frosted glass in card pages and plays looping animations once.
  - When the context fills up, it is trimmed in one larger step instead of one message at a time, so the model's cache keeps hitting: faster and cheaper (on by default).
  - Frontend cards' opening messages no longer show as raw code; card colors and web text are readable in dark mode; the Tavern screens have consistent spacing, styles and wording, with restrained motion.
- **Sharper companion room.** The room renders at the screen's own pixel density (it was capped at 2x before), and resolution lowered during stutters comes back once things are smooth.
- **New pet: Pink Fish.** A third built-in pet with 18 state animations and 3 idle moments; switching animations now fades.
- **Long share images.** Sharing as an image keeps the whole message and makes one long image instead of cutting off the end.
- **The local engine starts with tawcroot by default** (Android 10 and later): faster to start; if it can't start, the app falls back to the compatible launcher (PRoot) on its own without an error card. If you turned tawcroot off before, that is kept. On Zhuoyitong, when PRoot fails to start the error card offers Start with tawcroot.
- **Fixes.** New local chats failing after upgrading to 1.1.0; the local chat list failing to load once it grew past 8 MB; no network when the first of several configured DNS servers refused; API keys that couldn't be entered in plugin settings; phone control reporting "identity changed" on Android 10 after Shizuku authorization; HyperOS / Android 16 stuck at 60 Hz (the refresh rate setting now applies to the drawing surface too); a false out-of-space error when the APK was already downloaded; older messages showing the new image after a file at the same path was overwritten; a 404 from the model list now says models can be added by hand; long model names cut off in the model picker; the companion's automatic memory recall mistaking subagent settings for conversation; several display issues in pets, the floating menu, the companion widget and web islands.
- **Testing.** Most new features in this version have only been checked by automated tests and builds; tawcroot by default, background protection, remote backup and the web app have not been fully tried on a range of real devices. The iOS package will be added to this release once CI finishes; there is still no HarmonyOS HAP in this version. If you run into a problem, please export diagnostics and open an issue.

# YumEdit 1.4.0

## 更新内容

- 旧机型的“两步一键开启苹果智能”流程已完成真机验证。
- 修复 iPhone 13 及更早机型上，主板和芯片标识大小写不同造成的设备身份误判，例如 `D53gAP` 与 `D53GAP`；校验时不区分大小写，不改写缓存中的原始标识。

- 更新黑色主调图标及主页布局，设备状态卡随屏幕高度扩展并可在卡内滚动。

旧机型两步流程目前可能使听写失效，后续版本会继续处理。请在操作前备份整机；写入成功不代表所有系统功能均可正常使用。

下载文件为未签名 IPA，需要具备 App Group 权限的签名配置。

apps.name: S2Arm
apps.localizedDescription:
# S2Arm v0.6.7

这是 0.6.6 的修复版：iPhone / iPad 上大游戏的即时存档重新能用；修复部分游戏开局黑屏 / 画面残缺；修复推送续传白白重推、Apple TV 推完核对失败；修复部分游戏在 iPad 上开着即时存档 30–40 秒闪退；「地址空间不够」少了误报、说法改成人话；导出时总会带上本版 S2Arm.ipa；新增 iPhone 存储页和 Mac 本地联机。
*A fix release for 0.6.6: quick saves work again for big games on iPhone / iPad; some games no longer start on a black screen or with parts of the picture missing; resumed pushes no longer re-send everything and Apple TV post-push checks pass; it fixes some games closing 30–40 seconds in on iPad with quick saves on; "not enough address space" appears less often by mistake and is explained in plain words; and exports always include this version's S2Arm.ipa; plus a new iPhone Storage page and Mac local play.*

## 修复
- **iPhone / iPad 上大游戏的即时存档重新能用**：地址空间较大的设备上，多数大游戏原先整局关着即时存档——即时存档按整份标准布局判地址够不够，一个容器里装了多款游戏时还按其中最大的那款判。现在按这款游戏实际用到的地址判（随版本附带各款实测的地址用量），选好游戏后再放即时存档区，大多数大游戏都能开即时存档。
  *Quick saves work again for big games on iPhone / iPad. On devices with plenty of address space, most big games used to run with quick saves off for the whole session: room was judged against the full standard layout, and a container holding several games was judged by its largest game. S2Arm now judges by what the chosen game actually uses (the release carries measured address use per game) and places the quick save area after the game is chosen, so most big games can use quick saves.*
- **修复部分游戏在 iPad 上开着即时存档 30–40 秒闪退**：即时存档的虚拟池区原先占了 16 GB 地址，部分游戏在 iPad 上因此开局 30–40 秒就闪退。现在只占 2 GB。
  *Fixed some games closing 30–40 seconds in on iPad with quick saves on. The quick save virtual pool area used to take 16 GB of address space, which made some games close 30–40 seconds after starting on iPad. It now takes 2 GB.*
- **设置里关掉即时存档现在会真的关**：原先在设置里关了即时存档，游戏启动时仍按开着预留地址、记录操作，关了等于没关；现在一启动就按你的设置来，关了就不占地址、不记录。
  *Turning quick saves off in Settings now really turns them off. Before, games still reserved address space and recorded input at launch as if quick saves were on; your setting now applies from the very start.*
- **修复部分游戏开局黑屏 / 画面残缺（显存不足后被误记的跳过清单会自动清除）**：显存用满时，原先会把当时正在画的那批着色器记成「出错」并永久跳过，之后每局开局都黑屏或画面缺一块。现在显存不足不再记进跳过清单，旧版本记下的清单会自动作废、重新学。
  *Fixed some games starting on a black screen or with parts of the picture missing (a skip list wrongly recorded after running out of GPU memory is now cleared automatically). When GPU memory ran out, the shaders being drawn at that moment used to be recorded as faulty and skipped for good, so every later session started black or with part of the picture missing. Running out of GPU memory no longer adds to the skip list, and lists recorded by earlier versions are discarded and relearned.*
- **在 iPhone 上删过的游戏，再从电脑推会补上程序包**：原先只推资源，App 打开后报还缺 .s2arm、这款还是打不开。现在推之前核一下手机上程序包真在不在，不在就补推。
  *Games deleted on iPhone get their program package back when pushed again from the computer. Previously only the resources were sent and the app then reported the .s2arm missing, so the game still wouldn't open. The push now checks whether the program package is really on the phone and sends it if not.*
- **独立 App：装之前先说会顶掉哪个 App**：开发者证书只允许一个包名时，每款独立 App 都会装成同一个包名、顶掉手机上的上一款。现在装之前先问，不再装完才提示。
  *Standalone apps: you're asked before an install would replace another app. When a developer certificate allows only one bundle ID, every standalone app installs under it and replaces the previous one on the phone. You're now asked before installing, instead of being told afterwards.*
- **Mac：窗口切到后台不再把帧率压回 30 帧（#1949）**：窗口失焦、被遮住或睡眠时的低帧率不再算进帧率档位判断，回到前台不会整局停在 30 帧。
  *Mac: switching the window to the background no longer drops the frame rate back to 30 (#1949). Low frame rates while the window is unfocused, covered or asleep no longer count toward the frame-rate tier, so returning to the foreground no longer leaves the whole session at 30 fps.*
- **「更新这款」不再对 Vulkan / OpenGL 款反复失败**：这类款没有 Metal 直连库，原先每点一次都整单失败、「建议更新」永远消不掉。
  *"Update this game" no longer keeps failing for Vulkan / OpenGL games. These games have no Metal direct library, so every attempt used to fail and the "update recommended" note never went away.*
- **「地址空间不够」少了误报、说法改成人话**：只有这款游戏已知需要的地址确实比可用的多时才提示；提示里说清是系统能给 App 的地址范围，和存储空间无关。
  *"Not enough address space" appears less often by mistake and is explained in plain words. It now only appears when the game is known to need more address space than is available, and it explains that this is the address range the system can give the app, unrelated to storage space.*
- **导出时总会带上本版 S2Arm.ipa**：导出到文件夹时都会附上本版 S2Arm.ipa，游戏库也加了「导出 S2Arm.ipa」入口，说明里写清 IPA 的用途，方便 LiveContainer、SideStore、AltStore 等自签用户更新。
  *Exports always include this version's S2Arm.ipa. Exporting to a folder now always adds this version's S2Arm.ipa, the game library has a new "Export S2Arm.ipa" entry, and the instructions explain what the IPA is for — handy for LiveContainer, SideStore, AltStore and other self-signing users.*
- **修复推送续传白白重推、Apple TV 推完核对失败（#1942）**：推资源包时压缩用的线程数原先随可用内存变，同一块前后压出来的长度不一样：续传认不出已推好的块又从头推，Apple TV 推完核对连续三次失败报错。现在固定线程数，续传只推没推完的块、核对一次过；Windows 上「准备资源（测压缩率）」也不再卡在 0% 二十多分钟。
  *Fixed resumed pushes re-sending everything and Apple TV checks failing after a push (#1942). The number of compression threads used to change with free memory, so the same block came out a different length each time: resumed pushes didn't recognise blocks already sent and started over, and Apple TV's post-push check failed three times in a row. The thread count is now fixed, so resumes only send what's left and the check passes; on Windows, "Preparing resources (measuring compression)" no longer sits at 0% for over twenty minutes.*
- **修复部分游戏从第二局起读写大内存区出错**：用到远端内存段的游戏，窗口收窄后原先把尾部地址还给了系统，宿主的缓冲区落进去，第二局起远端段整段用不了。现在收窄时保留尾部，远端段照常可用。
  *Fixed some games failing to use a large memory region from the second session on. For games that use a far memory segment, trimming the window used to hand the tail back to the system; the host's buffers landed there and the far segment was unusable from the second session on. The tail is now kept when trimming, so the far segment works.*
- **「更新所选」遇到电脑上缺 iPhone 资源包的游戏，先出包再推**，不再报缺资源包。
  *"Update selected" now builds the iPhone resource package first for games that don't have one on the computer, instead of reporting it missing.*
- **体感操作更稳**：扣掉手柄自身的陀螺仪零偏（静止时学习），视角不再慢慢漂。
  *Steadier motion controls: the controller's own gyro drift is learned while still and removed, so the view no longer slowly drifts.*
- **手柄选择页换成双 Joy-Con 后，游戏不会再退回掌机模式**。

> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.20

Apps Manager backups, and safer handling of databases that are in use.

## New

- **Import Apps Manager backups** ([#19](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/19)): **Apps** → tap the app → **Import as Backup…** now accepts `.adbk` files from Apps Manager. The app's data is saved as a normal WQ Files backup, ready to restore.
  - Only the app's own data folder is imported. App Group data in the file isn't, because WQ Files backups don't include App Groups. The keychain items Apps Manager saves are encrypted, so they can't be imported either. When you import, WQ Files lists what it left out.
  - If the file says it belongs to a different app than the one you tapped, WQ Files asks first, as with any other import.
  - Opening an `.adbk` from the Files app or the share sheet doesn't start an import; start it from Apps.

## Fixed

- **Files another app is using:** deleting or replacing them, for example an app's database in its App Group while the app runs, failed with "Resource temporarily unavailable (errno 35)". WQ Files now says another app is using the file and that quitting that app and trying again should work. Its extensions or widgets can keep the file open even after you quit it.
- **Databases in use stay intact:** an app's database comes with `-wal` and `-shm` files next to it, and while the app runs, iOS doesn't lock the `-wal` file. WQ Files could delete or replace it while refusing the database file, which lost the app's newest data. Now a database and its `-wal`, `-shm` and `-journal` files are only changed together: if one of them is in use, none of them is touched. This applies to deleting (also whole folders), replacing on import and editing.
- **Deleting or importing several files at once:** each database is handled before its `-wal` and `-shm` files, which are skipped if the database itself couldn't be deleted or replaced. "N of M files were imported" is translated now.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to braless for the Apps Manager sample, and to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

apps.localizedDescription:
## What's new?

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

## Links
- Website: https://itslevii.dev

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

## Links
- Website: https://itslevii.dev

**目录 / Contents**：[简体中文](#-核心修复与优化) · [TestFlight 说明与免责](#-testflight-实验性说明与免责声明) · [English](#english) · [TestFlight Notice](#testflight-experimental-notice--disclaimer)

- **修复 Apple 下载/获取报错「暂时无法完成该操作」与诊断盲区**

  - 消除诊断盲区：Apple HTTP 200 plist 业务失败现自动写入严格脱敏的 `RequestFailureLog`（仅记录错误码、文档与弹窗标识，零隐私泄露），未知数字错误码亦会附带在提示末尾便于一眼定位。
- **「下载」页多选体验升级与统一撤销删除**
  - 「下载」页多选改为与「应用包」一致的就地勾选交互，同时纳入 **TestFlight** 任务支持全选与批量删除。
  - 常规下载与 TestFlight 删除（单条左滑或批量多选）统一接入 5 秒撤销倒计时栈，点击撤销可一次性恢复全部已删任务与文件。
- **安装包构建 SDK / Xcode 版本速查与交互修复**
  - 下载详情、应用包与 TestFlight 详情新增构建 **SDK 与 Xcode 版本**快捷查看（自动结合 `Info.plist` 与 Mach-O `LC_BUILD_VERSION` 解析）。
  - 修复专业模式「应用包」与「解密记录」列表左滑操作时整行变灰/出现半透明遮罩的问题。

  - **安全性与稳定性**：加固诊断脱敏与 TestFlight 多账号 Cookie 隔离、强化 `TFSINF` `cryptid` 校验，提升已购历史同步容错并消除页面生命周期竞态。

---

### 📢 官方频道与反馈说明

- **官方 Telegram 频道**：👉 [**https://t.me/ipadn_official**](https://t.me/ipadn_official)
- **GitHub Issues 仅保留只读归档**：新版安装包与源码优先在官方 Telegram 频道发布；使用问题、排障与 Bug 反馈请直接前往频道**对应版本贴文评论区**提交。

### ⚠️ TestFlight 实验性说明与免责声明

- **实验性功能提醒**：TestFlight 下载与原生安装为 `v2.3.x` 系列推出的**实验性功能**，受 Apple 服务端策略、账号当前有效 Beta 资格、本地网络/代理与本机配对影响，建议先使用备用 Apple 账号体验，勿分享配对文件、令牌或完整备份；详细用法与排障指南见 [README — TestFlight 实验性新功能](README.md#testflight-实验性新功能)。
- **免责声明**：iPadn 基于 [GPL-2.0-or-later](LICENSE) 开源，仅限个人合法备份、授权测试与技术研究，与 Apple Inc. 无关；因使用本工具带来的账号风控或数据风险由使用者自行承担。

- `iPadn-2.3.3-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，含实时活动（灵动岛、锁屏进度）与桌面小组件扩展，签名需要 2 个 App ID。

#### Fixes & Improvements Since v2.3.2

- **Fixed Apple Download Errors & Diagnostic Blind Spots**
  - Handles `failureType = 1008` (device verification / session expired) consistently with `2034 / 2042` across downloads, version tickets, free license acquisition, and Mac offers, plus explicit messages for password changes and disabled accounts.

  - Aligns **Downloads** multi-select with **Packages** using smooth in-place row selection covering both standard and **TestFlight** items (including Select All and bulk delete).
  - Unifies regular download and TestFlight deletions into a single 5-second Undo stack that restores both tasks and files together.

  - Displays compiled **SDK & Xcode versions** (from `Info.plist` and Mach-O `LC_BUILD_VERSION`) in Package & TestFlight details.
  - Fixes the gray veil/highlight dimming mask when swiping rows left in Pro mode **Packages** and **Decryption History**.

  - **Security & Stability**: Hardened diagnostic redaction, per-account TestFlight cookie isolation, `TFSINF` `cryptid` verification, owned-history resilience, and view lifecycle races.
  - **Scroll Smoothness**: Moved synchronous disk I/O off the main thread and improved icon/metadata caching for fluid scrolling across Downloads, Packages, Purchased, and TestFlight.
  - **UI, Accessibility & 11 Languages**: Completed 11-language localization & Arabic RTL polish, refined Light/Dark contrast, adaptive account avatars, and unified TestFlight icon placeholders.

- **Official Telegram Channel**: [**https://t.me/ipadn_official**](https://t.me/ipadn_official) (new builds & source archives land here first).
- **GitHub Issues Read-Only**: Please post support questions, TestFlight diagnostics, and bug reports under the matching release post in our Telegram channel.

#### TestFlight Experimental Notice & Disclaimer
- TestFlight download and native installation in `v2.3.x` are **experimental** and depend on Apple server behavior, active per-account invitations, proxy/DNS setup, and device pairing state. Testing with a secondary Apple Account first is recommended, and never share pairing files, tokens, or unencrypted backups (see [README_EN — TestFlight Experimental](README_EN.md#testflight-experimental)).
- Released under [GPL-2.0-or-later](LICENSE) for authorized personal testing, backups, and research; unaffiliated with Apple Inc., with all account or data risks assumed by the user.

#### Packages
- `iPadn-2.3.3-unsigned.ipa`: Standard build with Live Activities & Widgets (requires 2 App IDs).
- `iPadn-2.3.3-lite-unsigned.ipa`: Lite build without extensions (requires 1 App ID; identical core features).
- AltStore / SideStore / Feather repo: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`.

更早版本的更新内容见 [Releases](https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn/releases)。

- **Quick SDK / Xcode Build Inspection & Swipe Mask Fix**
  - Displays compiled **SDK & Xcode versions** (from `Info.plist` and Mach-O `LC_BUILD_VERSION`) in Package & TestFlight details.
  - Fixes the gray veil/highlight dimming mask when swiping rows left in Pro mode **Packages** and **Decryption History**.
